name: Sandro Ruotolo - § 63/3
title: REPORT on the impact of social media and the online environment on young people
part_text: ‘stresses the need for a harmonised EU approach to establishing a minimum digital age and, in this context, welcomes the conclusions of the Commission’s special panel of experts on child safety online, which provides guidance on this matter; welcomes, furthermore, the announcement made by President von der Leyen about a legislative proposal on the matter;’
